concept: Organizations: SCPs and consolidated billing for many accounts
tests: Which service centrally manages guardrails (SCPs) and consolidated billing for hundreds of accounts.
expected: AWS Organizations with Service Control Policies: OUs, consolidated billing, SCPs as permission guardrails. Triggers: "hundreds of accounts", "service control policies", "consolidate billing".
why_not: IAM Identity Center — user sign-in, not guardrails; Config aggregator — collects configurations; VPC sharing — networking, not account management.
